pacman::p_load(shiny,dplyr,scales,ggplot2,resample,DT,bslib,bsicons,tidyr,readxl,purrr,shinyFeedback) options(shiny.maxRequestSize=3000*1024^2, shiny.error=browser, shiny.reactlog=TRUE, shiny.trace=TRUE) # Set Lists ---- lnBins<-c(0,1, 1.09, 1.17617769624105, 1.33844763654849, 1.62995809876673, 2.11851240697691, 2.86922655453558, 3.92326905479411, 5.29019430360912, 6.95604927916568, 8.89566096004401, 11.0812245853201, 13.486476782673, 16.0881642462588, 18.8662481079173, 21.8036226191196, 24.885698750298, 28.0999920413904, 31.4357613345056, 34.8837074753731, 38.4357273610638, 42.0847147881313, 45.8243993937286, 49.6492160808486, 53.5541986823098, 57.5348928828957, 61.5872844793965, 65.7077399078392, 69.8929566332076, 74.1399215138969, 78.4458756529987, 82.8082845578576, 87.2248126692902, 91.6933015086885, 96.211750837395, 100.778302337684, 105.391225415564, 110.048904797879, 114.749829653943, 119.492584018385, 124.275838329407, 129.098341927126, 133.958916381574, 138.856449540348, 143.789890202718, 148.758243340963, 153.760565801272, 158.795962426256, 163.863582549218, 168.962616817169, 174.092294305358, 179.251879890988, 184.44067185795, 189.657999707973, 194.903222156647, 200.175725295382,500.02) Bin<-c(1, 1.09, 1.17617769624105, 1.33844763654849, 1.62995809876673, 2.11851240697691, 2.86922655453558, 3.92326905479411, 5.29019430360912, 6.95604927916568, 8.89566096004401, 11.0812245853201, 13.486476782673, 16.0881642462588, 18.8662481079173, 21.8036226191196, 24.885698750298, 28.0999920413904, 31.4357613345056, 34.8837074753731, 38.4357273610638, 42.0847147881313, 45.8243993937286, 49.6492160808486, 53.5541986823098, 57.5348928828957, 61.5872844793965, 65.7077399078392, 69.8929566332076, 74.1399215138969, 78.4458756529987, 82.8082845578576, 87.2248126692902, 91.6933015086885, 96.211750837395, 100.778302337684, 105.391225415564, 110.048904797879, 114.749829653943, 119.492584018385, 124.275838329407, 129.098341927126, 133.958916381574, 138.856449540348, 143.789890202718, 148.758243340963, 153.760565801272, 158.795962426256, 163.863582549218, 168.962616817169, 174.092294305358, 179.251879890988, 184.44067185795, 189.657999707973, 194.903222156647, 200.175725295382,">200") Outputs<-c("Velocity","Frequency","Percent") # Set Functions ---- ## Velocity/import ---- importDanio<-function(filename,num){ withProgress(message="Loading your files",value=0,{ d<-vector("list",num) for(i in 1:num){ sheets<-excel_sheets(filename[[i]]) plate<-read_excel(filename[[i]],sheet=1,range="B4") x<-lapply(sheets,function(x) read_excel(filename[[i]],sheet=x,range = "I39:I45040", col_names = FALSE)) x<-lapply(x,function(x) sort(x$...1,na.last=TRUE)) wells<-lapply(sheets,function(x) unlist(strsplit(x,"-"))[2]) plates<-gsub(" ","",colnames(plate)[1]) names(x)<-make.names(paste(plates,wells),unique=TRUE) d[[i]]<-x incProgress(1/num) } }) df<-data.frame(list_flatten(d)) colnames(df)<-names(list_flatten(d)) df } importZantiks<-function(filename,num){ #withProgress(message="Loading your files",value=0,{ d<-list() for(i in 1:num){ x<-read.csv(filename[i],header=TRUE) duration<-c(0,diff(x$RUNTIME)) y<-select(x,starts_with("DISTANCE")) y<-na.omit(apply(y,2,"/",MoreArgs=duration)) colnames(y)<-gsub("DISTANCE_",colnames(y),replacement=paste0("Trial",i,".")) d[[i]]<-y # incProgress(1/num) #} } df<-data.frame(d) df } ## Frequency ---- frequency<-function(velocity,bins,binNames){ freq<-data.frame(matrix(ncol = ncol(velocity), nrow = 57)) colnames(freq)<-colnames(velocity) withProgress(message="Processing...",value=0,{ for (i in colnames(velocity)){ f<-data.frame(table(cut(velocity[[i]],breaks=bins))) freq[[i]]<-as.numeric(f$Freq) incProgress(1/length(colnames(velocity))) } colnames(freq)<-colnames(velocity) rownames(freq)<-binNames freq }) } ## Percentage ---- percent<-function(frequency,binNames){ p<-data.frame(matrix(ncol=ncol(frequency),nrow=57)) x<-seq.int(1,ncol(frequency),1) withProgress(message="Processing...",value=0,{ for (i in x){ s<-sum(frequency[[i]]) p[[i]]<-100*frequency[[i]]/s incProgress(1/x) } colnames(p)<-colnames(frequency) rownames(p)<-binNames p }) } subDF<-function(data,ref,group){ f<-filter(ref,Experimental.Group == group) x<-unname(unlist(f[1])) data |> select(any_of(x)) } ## Bootstrapping ---- CI<-function(df,ref,group){ t<-t(subDF(df,ref,group)) b<-resample::bootstrap(data=t,statistic=colMeans,R=10000) c<-CI.percentile(x=b,confidence=0.95) means<-unname(colMeans(t)) low<-unname(c[,1]) high<-unname(c[,2]) d<-data.frame(means,low,high) colnames(d)<-paste0(group,"_",c("Means","LowBound","HighBound")) d } bootGroups<-function(Groups,Data,Key,Bins){ rh<-rep(Groups,each=3) l<-seq(from=1,to=length(Groups),by=1) x<-data.frame(matrix(ncol=(length(Groups)*3),nrow=nrow(Data))) for(i in l){ p<-(i*3)-2 sp<-seq(from=p,length.out=3) c<-CI(Data,Key,Groups[i]) x[p]<-c[1] x[p+1]<-c[2] x[p+2]<-c[3] } x<-cbind(Bin[1:nrow(x)],x) colnames(x)<-c("Bin",paste0(rh,"_",c("Means","LowBound","HighBound"))) x } ## Graphing ---- longForm<-function(Bin,Group,Boot){ Bins<-as.numeric(Bin[1:nrow(Boot)]) Y<-paste0(Group,"_Means") L<-paste0(Group,"_LowBound") U<-paste0(Group,"_HighBound") avg<-Boot |> select(any_of(Y)) avg<- cbind(Bins,avg) colnames(avg)<-c("Bins",Group) low<-Boot |> select(any_of(L)) low<- cbind(Bins,low) colnames(low)<-c("Bins",Group) up<-Boot |> select(any_of(U)) up<- cbind(Bins,up) colnames(up)<-c("Bins",Group) dataAvg <- avg %>% pivot_longer(cols=Group,names_to="Group",values_to="Mean") dataLow <- low %>% pivot_longer(cols=Group,names_to="Group",values_to="LowBound") dataUp <- up %>% pivot_longer(cols=Group,names_to="Group",values_to="HighBound") al<-merge(x=dataAvg,y=dataLow,by=c("Bins","Group")) pb<-merge(x=al,y=dataUp,by=c("Bins","Group")) pb } # UI ---- ui <- page_fillable( shinyFeedback::useShinyFeedback(), theme=bs_theme(bootswatch = "lumen"), fillable=TRUE, navset_tab( ## Tab: Import ---- nav_panel("Import Files", selectInput("system","Behavioral System",choices=(c("Daniovision","Zantiks","Other")),selected="Daniovision",multiple=FALSE), conditionalPanel( condition = "input.system == 'Daniovision'", layout_columns(col_widths=c(4,8), card( card_header("Daniovision Upload"), fileInput("importDanio", label="Select all files in one batch", placeholder="Upload", buttonLabel=bsicons::bs_icon("collection"),accept=".xlsx",multiple=TRUE), ), card( card_header("Uploaded Files"), tableOutput("uploads")) ) ), conditionalPanel( condition = "input.system == 'Zantiks'", layout_columns(col_widths=c(4,8), card( card_header("Zantiks Upload"), fileInput("importZantiks", label="Select all files in one batch", placeholder="Upload", buttonLabel=bsicons::bs_icon("collection"),accept=".csv",multiple=TRUE), ), card( card_header("Uploaded Files"), tableOutput("uploads")) )), conditionalPanel( condition="input.system == 'Other'", card( card_header("Other System"), "Unfortunately, this app only supports imports from Daniovision or Zantiks systems.", "See our ReadMe for information on how to format your data to be read by our Zantiks process" ) ) ), ## Tab: Set Groups ---- nav_panel( title = "Set Groups", layout_columns( col_widths = c(4,4,4), card( card_header("Set your groups"), "Download the template, which is populated with all your wells, using this button", downloadButton("grpDown",label="Download template"), "Upload the filled template here:", fileInput("grpUp",label="Filled template",placeholder="Upload filled template",multiple=FALSE,accept=".csv"), ), card( card_header("Define your groups"), selectInput("exclude","Exclude Group(s):",choices = c("Your groups will populate here"),multiple = TRUE), selectInput("normalize","Normalize To:",choices = c("Your groups will populate here"),multiple = FALSE), ), card( card_header("Preview Groups"), tableOutput("groupList"), textOutput("checkGroup") ) ), ), ## Tab: Export Analysis ---- nav_panel( title = "Data Table Exports", layout_columns( col_widths = c(4,8), card( card_header("Export Options"), selectInput("switch","Options:",Outputs), checkboxInput("tidy","Remove excluded group(s)?"), downloadButton("Down")), card( card_header("Export Preview"), dataTableOutput("preview.data")) )), ## Tab: Normalize ---- nav_panel( title="Normalize", layout_columns( col_widths = c(4,8), card( card_header("Normalize by:"), selectInput("norm","Group to Normalize",choices = c("Your groups will populate here"),multiple = FALSE), downloadButton("normsDown",label = "Download this group"), ), card( card_header("Normalized Data Preview"), dataTableOutput("norms")), )), ## Tab: Graphs ---- nav_panel( title="Graphs", card( card_header("Graph Options"), layout_columns( selectInput("bt","Graph Type",choices = c("Logarithmic","Normalized"),multiple = FALSE), checkboxGroupInput("btGrp","Groups to Plot",choices="Your choices will appear here",inline=TRUE), selectInput("lineCol","Line Colors (in order of checkboxes)",choices=colors(),multiple = TRUE), card(selectInput("graphExt","Download Graph As:",choices=c(".eps",".ps",".tex",".pdf",".jpeg",".tiff",".png",".bmp",".svg",".wmf")), downloadButton("graphDown", label="Download Graph")) ) ), card( card_header("Graph:"), actionButton("graph","Graph!"), plotOutput("graph.test") ) )), htmlOutput("LabLogo")) # Server ---- server <- function(input, output, session) { src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/d98763_de8367afb91449b78aebda6bf4eecdc1~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_858,h_144,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/d98763_de8367afb91449b78aebda6bf4eecdc1~mv2.jpg" output$LabLogo<-renderText({c('')}) # List of Uploaded Files ---- imports<-reactive({ switch( input$system, "Daniovision"=input$importDanio$datapath, "Zantiks"=input$importZantiks$datapath ) }) output$uploads<-renderTable({ imports() }) # Run functions/Process data ---- vel<-reactive({ i<- switch( input$system, "Daniovision"=importDanio(imports(),length(imports())), "Zantiks"=importZantiks(imports(),length(imports())) ) if(input$tidy==TRUE){ i[,exd()] } else { i } }) freq<-reactive({ i<-frequency(vel(),lnBins,Bin) if(input$tidy==TRUE){ i[,exd()] } else { i } }) perc<-reactive({ i<-percent(freq(),Bin) if(input$tidy==TRUE){ i[,exd()] } else { i } }) ## Preview & Download Processed Data ---- ### Preview output$preview.data<-renderDataTable({ validate( need(imports(),"Upload your data to begin"), need(input$switch,"Choose your output type") ) switch(input$switch, "Velocity" = vel(), "Frequency" = freq(), "Percent" = perc() ) }) ### Downloads output$Down<-downloadHandler( filename=paste(input$switch,".csv",sep=""), content=function(file){ write.csv( x=switch(input$switch, "Velocity" = vel(), "Frequency" = freq(), "Percent" = perc() ), file=file) }) # Process Groups ---- ## Create template for defining groups # Use uploaded files to make a list of all entries temp<-reactive({ d<-data.frame(matrix(nrow = ncol(vel()), ncol = 1),row.names=colnames(vel())) colnames(d)<-c("Experimental.Group") d }) # Download a .csv with all entries and space for adding group output$grpDown<-downloadHandler( filename="Groups.csv", content=function(file){ write.csv(temp(),file) } ) ## Import filled template filled<-reactive({ grpUp<-input$grpUp if (is.null(grpUp)) { return(NULL) } read.csv(grpUp$datapath,header=TRUE) }) groupCheck<-reactive({ req(filled()) req(vel()) a<-colnames(vel()) b<-filled()[,1] x<-if(identical(a,b)==TRUE){ "Your data matches your groupings!" } else { "Your groupings don't match your data. Please check your template!" } }) output$checkGroup<-renderText( groupCheck() ) # Make a list of all groups g<-reactive({ req(filled()) as.list(unique(filled()[2])) }) # Update options for users to select exclusions & normalize group observe({updateSelectInput(session,"exclude",choices = g())}) observe({updateSelectInput(session,"normalize",choices = h())}) # Make a list of all non-excluded groups and set those as options for normalized output h<-reactive({ n<-unname(unlist(g())) h<-n[!n %in% input$exclude] h }) observe({updateSelectInput(session,"norm",choices=h())}) # Make a list of all non-excluded Wells exd<-reactive({ req(filled()) e<-unlist(input$exclude) f<-filter(filled(),Experimental.Group !=e) unname(unlist(f[1])) }) # Normalize all wells to the control group norm<-reactive({ req(filled()) n<-unlist(input$normalize) c<-unname(unlist(filter(filled(),Experimental.Group == n)[1])) Norm<-unname(rowMeans(perc()[,c])) err<-ifelse(is.infinite(min(which(Norm==0))),ncol(perc()),min(which(Norm==0))-1) rws<-seq(1,err,by=1) p<-perc()[rws,] a<-apply(p,2,"/",MoreArgs=Norm[rws]) df<-data.frame(unname(a)) rownames(df)<-Bin[rws] colnames(df)<-colnames(perc()) df }) # Make a table of counts per group to confirm defined<-reactive({ req(filled()) req(g()) f<- filled() |> group_by(Experimental.Group) grouped<-data.frame(tally(f)) grouped$p<-round(100*grouped$n/sum(grouped$n),digits=1) colnames(grouped)<-c("Group","Count","Percent") grouped }) output$groupList<-renderTable(defined()) # Make a data table of selected group's wells, normalized to control normFiltered<-reactive({ req(norm()) n<-as.character(input$norm) subDF(norm(),filled(),n) }) output$norms<-renderDataTable({ validate( need(imports(),"Upload your data to begin"), need(input$grpUp,"Upload your group data to proceed"), need(input$normalize,"Choose your normalization group") ) normFiltered() }) normGroup<-reactive({ as.character(input$norm) }) output$normsDown<-downloadHandler( filename=function(){ paste(normGroup(),"_Normalized.csv",sep="") }, content=function(file){ write.csv(normFiltered(),file) } ) # Make Matlab Graphs ---- ## Bootstrapping ---- norm.boot<-reactive({ bootGroups(h(),norm(),filled(),Bin) }) perc.boot<-reactive({ bootGroups(h(),perc(),filled(),Bin) }) ## Graphs ---- observe({updateCheckboxGroupInput(session,"btGrp",choices = sort(h()))}) graphs<-eventReactive(input$graph, { req(input$btGrp) Graph<-switch(input$bt, "Logarithmic"=longForm(Bin,input$btGrp,perc.boot()), "Normalized"=longForm(Bin,input$btGrp,norm.boot())) ggplot(Graph, aes(x=Bins,y=Mean,color=Group,fill=Group)) + geom_line(size=2)+ geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = LowBound, ymax = HighBound),alpha = 0.2)+ theme( panel.border = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = "black", linewidth = 2), panel.background = element_rect(fill="transparent"), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16), )+ xlab("Speed (mm/sec)")+ guides(color="legend")+ scale_fill_manual(values=input$lineCol)+ scale_color_manual(values=input$lineCol)+ {if(input$bt=="Logarithmic")list(scale_y_log10(labels = label_log()),ylab("Percent of Time (log)"))}+ {if(input$bt=="Normalized")list(ylim(c(0,4)),ylab(paste0("Percent of Time, Normalized to ",input$normalize)))} }) output$boot.test<-renderPrint("Text") output$graph.test<-renderPlot({ graphs() }) graphExt<-reactive({ paste0(input$bt,input$graphExt) }) output$graphDown <- downloadHandler( filename = function(){graphExt()}, content = function(file){ ggsave(file,plot=graphs()) }) } # App ---- shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
